channel.title: Egypt - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Egypt, every source cited.

item.title: Egypt medicinal plant exports reach $852m
item.description: Exports of dried herbs, extracts and oils grew from around $400m in previous years to $852m in 2025.

item.title: Cairo Water Week becomes global dialogue platform
item.description: The ninth edition of Cairo Water Week, held October 25-29, featured 137 sessions and broad international participation.

item.title: Egypt shops adjust to winter hours
item.description: Retailers will close at 10:00 pm, while restaurants can stay open until midnight.

item.title: Bus crash kills three on Red Sea highway
item.description: 25 people were injured, including five foreign nationals, when a bus collided with a sand truck.
